description: This file defines the 'Setting' class within the OpenCart admin controller namespace, responsible for handling events related to settings, specifically for adding tasks after certain setting edits.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class handling setting-related events in the OpenCart admin panel. It adds specific tasks after the 'setting/setting.editSetting' route is triggered.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the event after a setting is edited. Adds language, currency, and location tasks based on configuration and route conditions.
